title: Frequently asked
lead: Still unsure about something? We answer email in under a day.

free.question: Is TabMerger really free?
free.answer: Yes! The free tier includes all the core features — up to {groups} groups, {tabs} tabs, {urlRules} URL rules, drag-and-drop, and import/export. You only pay if you want cloud sync, unlimited groups, tabs and URL rules, or AI features.

sync.question: How does cloud sync work?
sync.answer: When you sign up for a Pro or Pro AI plan, your groups are automatically saved to our servers. Your groups sync across every browser where you're signed in — sync runs whenever the popup is open, so changes show up the next time you open it there.

ai.question: What does the AI do exactly?
ai.answer: The Pro AI tier unlocks five AI features: auto-grouping (analyzes your open tabs and groups them logically), smart naming (suggests names for your groups), tab summaries (a short summary of a page when you hover its tab), session suggestions (proposes merging groups that overlap or archiving ones you haven't used in a while), and Organize (reviews all your groups and proposes merges, renames, archives and a new order, for you to check before applying).

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: Absolutely. You can cancel anytime from your account page. You'll keep access until the end of your current billing period, then drop back to the free tier.

browsers.question: Which browsers does TabMerger support?
browsers.answer: Chrome (Chrome Web Store), Edge (Edge Add-ons, or the Chrome Web Store), Brave, Vivaldi, and Arc (Chrome Web Store), Opera (Chrome Web Store, via Opera's "Install Chrome Extensions" add-on), and Firefox (Firefox Add-ons). Safari isn't supported.

privacy.question: Is my data private?
privacy.answer: We take privacy seriously. Free tier data is stored locally only — nothing leaves your browser. Pro cloud sync data is end-to-end encrypted on your device with a passphrase only you know before it ever reaches our servers — we store only ciphertext and cannot read your groups or tabs. We never sell your data.

downgrade.question: What happens to my groups if I downgrade?
downgrade.answer: If you downgrade from Pro to Free, your groups remain in the cloud for 30 days. Your local tabs are always kept. You can export everything before downgrading.
